item.title: Exploring Edward Hopper's Hometown Legacy

item.title: 6th Circuit Allows Ohio Proof-of-Citizenship Voting Law
item.description: A federal appeals court ruled Wednesday that Ohio may enforce its proof-of-citizenship requirement for midterm voting, in a 2-1 decision.
